system.description:
As an action you can shift a patch of earth within ten yards of you into a shape you desire. You can move at most an amount of earth roughly equal to twice the size of a person. Below are some examples of what it can be used for.

You may shape earth into spikes or strike with blunt earth, making a Ninjutsu attack and dealing 8 + Arcane Might piercing damage or 6 + Arcane Might blunt damage.

You may attempt to bind a target, fully restraining them on a successful Ninjutsu roll against their Strength + Agility. They may attempt to break free each turn afterwards as an action with a pure Strength roll against your Ninjutsu.
